name: daily-driver
notes: Moved from the legacy .claude/tier.json to the runtime-neutral .agent-harness/tier.json on 2026-07-27; the legacy file was deleted in the same commit. The floor dispatcher reads both locations (declared_project_dirs / merged tier config), so hook behaviour is unchanged. 'name' was also corrected from 'daily driver' to the canonical 'daily-driver' that harness.py audit requires.
human_todo alias: ACTION_ITEMS.md is the grandfathered HUMAN_TODO for this repo (recorded in ~/.claude/ESTATE.md).

authority.merge is the T2 default 'free' (owner directive agent-harness #91; rollout #101, landed here in PR #482). The one repo-specific hold is NOT a tier gate: browser-surface PRs (runtime blast radius, not file type) wait for the human Gate-3 manual Chrome run tracked in ACTION_ITEMS.md.

One floor per runtime: Claude receives the canonical global ~/.claude/hooks/dispatch.py; Codex's sole project PreToolUse adapter pins and invokes that same dispatcher with --runtime codex. Repo-local .claude/hooks/{dispatch,smoke_test}.py are vendored canonical CI/audit fixtures, not a second runtime hook. Repo-tier SessionStart/PostToolUse handlers stay in scripts/agent_hooks/.

Stricter-local tripwires live in .claude/settings.json deny (npm publish / chrome-webstore-upload / web-ext sign / git filter-branch / chmod -R 777) — release/permission tripwires the irreversible floor deliberately does not cover.

Dual-runtime (Claude + Codex): .agents/skills mirrors .claude/skills; name drift is enforced by scripts/agent_hooks/validate_skills.py (npm run agent:skills:validate), so the forked-mirror risk in BLUEPRINT §7 is controlled.

GitHub branch protection on main is ABSENT as of 2026-07-06 (the real wall per BLUEPRINT law 5). Tracked as a human action in ACTION_ITEMS.md; until enabled, the floor blocks bare force-push everywhere but --force-with-lease to main is allowed at T2.
